name: Aaloktronix
old_description: As a leading electronics contract manufacturer (ECM) in Seattle, USA, AalokTronix (ATI) provides electronics manufacturing services (EMS) and helps you with all your product development needs. Given our 40+ years of cumulative experience in electronics manufacturing/contract manufacturing, we have a long list of loyal clients.
about:
Aaloktronix, doing business as AalokTronix Inc. (ATI), is an electronics contract manufacturer headquartered in Seattle, Washington. The company does not publish its founding date or ownership details, though its website credits Kishan Ghadiya as the author of its primary content.

The firm provides full-spectrum electronics manufacturing services (EMS), including PCB assembly (prototype and turnkey), final assembly, electronic assembly, design and engineering (PCB layout, schematic capture, design for manufacturability), cable and wire harness assembly, circuit troubleshooting and repair, and quick-turn prototyping. It emphasizes automated electronic assembly, paperless documentation, and barcode tracking for traceability. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Aaloktronix serves aerospace, defense, medical, commercial, IoT, industrial, agriculture, and automotive sectors. The company highlights aerospace-grade and medical-device PCB assembly as specialized offerings, along with custom wire and cable harnesses built to aerospace specifications.

The company positions itself on accommodating service—accepting customer-provided instructions or kits—high reliability through inspection at every production step, and punctual delivery regardless of order size. Its stated differentiator is a rapid prototyping timeline: a hardware prototype in as little as three weeks and a manufacturable product in under ten weeks.
